pkgmetadata.longdescription: Goverlay is a Qt6 graphical user interface for configuring Linux gaming overlays and frame-generation tools, including MangoHud, vkBasalt, vkSumi, OptiScaler, Lossless Scaling (lsfg-vk), and per-game bgmod launch wrappers. It includes the integrated PasCube Vulkan/CPU benchmark with direct leaderboard submission to PascubeDB.
